Specification: A core TLA+ proof system module (TLAPS) that formalises essential inference rules for temporal logic and proof automation. It defines standard proof rules for invariant preservation (INV1, INV2), liveness under fairness (WF1, SF1, WF2, SF2), and basic TLA axioms. Additionally, it provides a comprehensive set of boolean flags to configure and control various provers (Zenon, Isabelle, SMT) within the TLA+ Proof System environment.
TheoremNames: RuleTLA1 == ASSUME STATE P, STATE f, P /\ (f' = f) => P' PROVE  []P <=> P /\ [][P => P']_f
RuleTLA2 == ASSUME STATE P, STATE Q, STATE f, STATE g, ACTION A, ACTION B, P /\ [A]_f => Q /\ [B]_g PROVE  []P /\ [][A]_f => []Q /\ [][B]_g
RuleINV1 == ASSUME STATE I, STATE F,  ACTION N, I /\ [N]_F => I' PROVE  I /\ [][N]_F => []I
RuleINV2 == ASSUME STATE I, STATE f, ACTION N PROVE  []I => ([][N]_f <=> [][N /\ I /\ I']_f)
RuleWF1 == ASSUME STATE P, STATE Q, STATE f, ACTION N, ACTION A, P /\ [N]_f => (P' / Q'), P /\ <<N /\ A>>_f => Q', P => ENABLED <<A>>_f PROVE  [][N]_f /\ WF_f(A) => (P ~> Q)

RuleSF1 == ASSUME STATE P, STATE Q, STATE f, ACTION N, ACTION A, TEMPORAL F, P /\ [N]_f => (P' / Q'), P /\ <<N /\ A>>_f => Q', []P /\ [][N]_f /\ []F => <> ENABLED <<A>>_f PROVE  [][N]_f /\ SF_f(A) /\ []F => (P ~> Q)

RuleWF2 == ASSUME STATE P, STATE f, STATE g, STATE EM, ACTION A, ACTION B, ACTION N, ACTION M, TEMPORAL F, <<N /\ B>>_f => <<M>>_g, P /\ P' /\ <<N /\ A>>_f /\ EM => B, P /\ EM => ENABLED A, [][N /\ ~B]_f /\ WF_f(A) /\ []F /\ <>[]EM => <>[]P PROVE  [][N]_f /\ WF_f(A) /\ []F => []<><<M>>_g / []<>(~EM)

RuleSF2 == ASSUME STATE P, STATE f, STATE g, STATE EM, ACTION A, ACTION B, ACTION N, ACTION M, TEMPORAL F, <<N /\ B>>_f => <<M>>_g, P /\ P' /\ <<N /\ A>>_f /\ EM => B, P /\ EM => ENABLED A, [][N /\ ~B]_f /\ SF_f(A) /\ []F /\ []<>EM => <>[]P PROVE  [][N]_f /\ SF_f(A) /\ []F => []<><<M>>_g / <>
RuleInvImplication == ASSUME STATE F, STATE G, F => G PROVE  []F => []G
RuleStepSimulation == ASSUME STATE I, STATE f, STATE g, ACTION M, ACTION N, I /\ I' /\ [M]_f => [N]_g PROVE  []I /\ [][M]_f => [][N]_g
